Dear Dr. Author:

Manuscript ID EX-2026-0001 entitled "An invented manuscript" has been reviewed. The comments of the reviewers are included at the bottom of this letter.

Sincerely,
The Editorial Office
Editor-in-Chief, Journal of Examples

Associate Editor Comments to the Author:
Please shorten the abstract to 200 words.

Reviewer(s)' Comments to Author:

Reviewer: 1

Comments to the Author
The manuscript describes a growth assay. The work is clear but the methods need detail.

1. State the incubation temperature with its unit.
2. Report the number of replicates in Table
2. The legend does not give it.
3. Please add the following to the Methods:
   a) the strain
   b) the medium

Reviewer: 2

Comments to the Author
The study is sound. I recommend adding error bars to Fig. 2 and naming the antifoam agent.
